verdicts.reason: Both have the same structural flaws. The 'LIMITED SUMMER RELEASE' eyebrow has dropped below the headline and is too small to read, the orange divider has drifted under the legal text where it means nothing, the SOLSTICE wordmark is barely visible, and 'Small-Batch' nearly touches the canvas edges. A keeps the spacing fairly even between the headline, body, CTA and legal text. B leaves large dead gaps around the eyebrow and body copy, then jams the legal text right under the 'Reserve a Case' button, so it looks unplanned.
